C-REPO-AUDIT-V1.IntentSummary: Add the smart-audit skill, its rubrics, a dependency-free scoring/lint/diff/report CLI with tests, and a thin Claude Code plugin wrapper, without changing the smart-review skill.

T-001.Title: Schemas and scoring core of the CLI

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: JSON Schemas for findings, recon, and run metadata exist; score computes deductions and caps from findings and is idempotent.

T-002.Title: Rubric criteria lists and prose for five audits

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Each of the five rubrics has a prose file and a criteria list with question, version, and criteria that agree with each other.

T-003.Title: lint, diff, and report commands with golden fixtures

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: lint accepts a valid run and rejects each deliberately broken fixture with its rule identifier; diff classifies findings against a previous run; report writes Markdown and one self-contained HTML file.

T-004.Title: smart-audit skill: orchestrator, recon, auditor, verifier, references

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: skills/smart-audit has SKILL.md, agent prompts, and references describing profiles, run layout, guidance and accepted-risk files, sequential fallback, and the lint gate; skills/smart-review is unchanged.

T-005.Title: Claude Code plugin manifest and audit command

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A plugin manifest and an audit command exist at the repository root and contain no logic beyond delegating to the skill.

T-006.Title: Package manifest, Makefile targets, and CI job for CLI tests

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: package.json exposes the CLI as a bin with no dependencies; make test runs the node:test suite; CI runs it with pinned actions and a read-only token.

T-007.Title: README, CHANGELOG, SECURITY, and a synthetic example report

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Docs explain the audit, installation, limits, and the audit threat model; the example report is generated from a synthetic repository by the CLI.
